templates.title: Onboarding and stage plan
templates.audience: Undergraduate, master's and doctoral students, including international students
templates.stage: Joining a group; starting a stage
templates.description: Align requirements, objectives, resources and assessable tasks; includes international student checks for language, programme stages and administrative arrangements.

templates.title: Research task card
templates.audience: Undergraduate research trainees and master's researchers · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Research training and execution
templates.description: Turn one research question into a minimum objective, steps, evidence and follow-up actions.

templates.title: Topic justification and scope
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Topic selection and research-question refinement
templates.description: Compare candidate problems and examine real needs, scope, feasibility and stopping conditions.

templates.title: Undergraduate project task brief: working draft
templates.audience: Undergraduate graduation-project students
templates.stage: After topic selection; before formal task issuance
templates.description: Define individual tasks, technical requirements, stage deliverables and review methods before completing the official university form.

templates.title: Literature review and evidence matrix
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Literature review, proposal and thesis writing
templates.description: Preserve search and screening decisions, compare evidence and develop traceable research judgments.

templates.title: Paper reading and reproduction decision
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Reading and reproduction preparation
templates.description: Explain a paper's problem, method, evidence and limitations, and decide whether reproduction is worthwhile.

templates.title: Research proposal and review preparation
templates.audience: Undergraduate graduation-project and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Proposal development and review
templates.description: Connect questions, methods, evaluation, milestones and review revisions; official university forms take precedence.

templates.title: Experiments, reproduction and run evidence
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Experiment design, execution and verification
templates.description: Record configurations, raw logs, failures, metrics and checks; distinguish live execution from saved-record replay.

templates.title: Requirements, detailed design and test report
templates.audience: Undergraduate project and competition teams; master's engineering projects · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Requirements, design, implementation and testing
templates.description: Connect requirement IDs to design, implementation, actual tests and defects to support an engineering delivery.

templates.title: Professional-practice plan and report
templates.audience: Professional master's students
templates.stage: Practice application, execution and assessment
templates.description: Record formal practice prerequisites, tasks, progress, conclusions and recognition separately from independent internships.

templates.title: Progress report and next-stage plan
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Day-to-day research and periodic reporting
templates.description: Report actual outputs, blockers and evidence against previous commitments, then propose feasible next steps.

templates.title: Meeting, discussion and decision record
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students; project teams · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Regular meetings, supervision and project collaboration
templates.description: Separate suggestions, decisions and pending approvals, with owners, deliverables, dates and verification.

templates.title: Competition planning, submission and reflection
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's competition participants
templates.stage: Participation decision, preparation, submission and reflection
templates.description: Verify current competition rules and connect judging criteria to team tasks, validation, submission and archiving.

templates.title: Topic, plan and resource change request
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Changes to scope, schedule, data or resources
templates.description: Preserve the original plan and record evidence, impact, alternatives and the actual confirmation status.

templates.title: Institutional requirements and annual progress record
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Semester, annual and stage reviews
templates.description: Record applicable institutional rules, versions and checks for courses, practice, thesis checks, examination, defense and degree procedures.

templates.title: Midterm review and corrective actions
templates.audience: Undergraduate graduation-project and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Midterm review, corrections and follow-up
templates.description: Check progress and evidence against the approved plan, assess remaining work and track required corrections.

templates.title: Thesis writing and version checks
templates.audience: Undergraduate graduation-project and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Thesis drafting, review and finalization
templates.description: Connect chapter claims to evidence and check figures, citations, anonymous copies and final archive versions.

templates.title: Output requirements and achievement register
templates.audience: Undergraduates; academic and professional master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Output planning and application-eligibility checks
templates.description: Verify requirements for the applicable program and record submission, acceptance and publication as distinct actual states.

templates.title: Academic integrity, non-academic-error and similarity checks
templates.audience: Undergraduate graduation-project and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Before examination, defense and final submission
templates.description: Record the applicable rules and corrections for academic integrity, non-academic-error checks, similarity checking and AI disclosure separately.

templates.title: AI assistance and disclosure record
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Throughout research, writing, competitions and submission
templates.description: Record actual purposes, adopted content, input-data boundaries, human verification and applicable disclosure requirements.

templates.title: Thesis examination and point-by-point responses
templates.audience: Undergraduate graduation-project and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Examination submission, revisions and re-examination
templates.description: Check the submission version and anonymity requirements; record each comment, thesis change and actual follow-up review.

templates.title: Defense preparation and revision acceptance
templates.audience: Undergraduate graduation-project and master's students · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Pre-defense, formal defense and revisions
templates.description: Prepare eligibility documents, the presentation, evidence and demonstrations; record questions and complete the revision process.

templates.title: Data, code and graduation-material archive
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students; project teams · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Stage freezes, paper submission and graduation archiving
templates.description: Check materials, permissions, versions, SHA-256 checksums and recovery instructions, recording what was actually verified.

templates.title: Stage handover and group departure
templates.audience: Undergraduate and master's students; project teams · Doctoral students where applicable
templates.stage: Personnel changes, graduation and group departure
templates.description: Transfer materials, systems, access, assets and unfinished work, with actual spot checks by the incoming owner.

templates.title: Learning review and next-step plan
templates.audience: Undergraduate, master’s and doctoral students, including international students
templates.stage: After feedback, at stage completion and when moving to a new task
templates.description: Connect your starting point, actual evidence, feedback and a transfer task; agree on the next learning goal and review date.

templates.title: Cross-institution training and supervision agreement: working draft
templates.audience: Undergraduate research, competition and capstone students; master's and doctoral students, including international students
templates.stage: Starting joint training; hosting or sending students; co-supervision and changes
templates.description: Agree learning goals, responsibilities, resources, feedback, output permissions and completion arrangements. Record actual confirmations separately; this draft does not replace formal agreements or approvals.

templates.title: Cross-institution milestone and recognition register
templates.audience: Undergraduate research, competition and capstone students; master's and doctoral students, including international students
templates.stage: Throughout joint training; formal milestones, return and recognition
templates.description: Check both institutions’ requirements, sources, deadlines and responsible bodies. Distinguish research completion, supervisory confirmation, institutional approval and formal recognition, with differences and actions tracked.

templates.title: Research and competition collaboration interest
templates.audience: Undergraduate, master's and doctoral students, including students at other institutions and overseas
templates.stage: First contact; exploring interests; preparing research or competition collaboration
templates.description: Briefly introduce interests, learning goals, shareable work, availability and support needs. Includes an adaptable first-contact message and welcomes students new to research.
